description: Quote a YES or NO buy on a Panta market for a USDC amount and wallet: expected shares, average fill price, fee and price impact against the spot price. Nothing is signed or sent. Powered by Panta. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amountUsdc.description: USDC to spend, as a decimal string, e.g. "5.00"

id.description: Panta market id (the market's event address, base58), from GET /api/markets

wallet.description: The buyer's Solana wallet (base58). It pays and signs; SiteCheck never does.

title: Markets Quote
